raw.query: SELECT la.arm, la.ttft_p99_ms as live_p99, inf.achieved_p99_ms as sim_p99, inf.is_violation as sim_violation, CASE WHEN la.ttft_p99_ms > 1000 THEN 'FAIL' ELSE 'PASS' END as live_verdict, CASE WHEN inf.is_violation THEN 'FAIL' ELSE 'PASS' END as sim_verdict, la.replica_seconds as live_replica_s, lrs.gpu_hours * 3600 as sim_gpu_seconds, ROUND(((la.replica_seconds - lrs.gpu_hours * 3600) / (lrs.gpu_hours * 3600) * 100)::numeric, 2) as replica_pct_diff FROM live_arm la JOIN v_infraction inf ON inf.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND inf.run_id = CASE la.arm WHEN 'live_fc' THEN 'live:twin_fc' WHEN 'live_re' THEN 'live:twin_re' END JOIN llm_run_summary lrs ON lrs.run_id = inf.run_id WHERE la.is_thesis_arm ORDER BY la.arm
raw.observed: live_fc: live=PASS(695ms) sim=FAIL(2164ms); live_re: replica-time off 53.83%
raw.claimed: forecast passes live exactly as simulated; replica-time within 8%
raw.evidence: Forecast verdicts are opposite (live PASS vs sim FAIL); reactive replica-time 53.83% off exceeds 8% bound
raw.fix: The twin_fc simulation (quantile=null, K1) produces p99=2164ms (FAIL) while the live forecast arm achieves 695ms (PASS) — the verdict directions disagree. Either the wrong twin is paired as the simulation counterpart, or the claim's 'exactly as simulated' is false. Additionally live_re replica_seconds=1799 vs sim=3896 is a 53.83% gap, far beyond 8%.
